text:
Sam Nguyen: Quick check — planning to enable a precision-profile cascade for sherpa-v2: fp16 -> int8 (no int4 yet) on a small canary (5%). Need agreement on audience gating and rollback guards. experiment_id: sherpa-quant-2026-03
Maria Chen: +1 on canary with strict quality gates. Please attach the prod prompt set 'prod-smoke-2026' and require token_loss < 0.02 as a precondition. Also add an hallucination metric watch.
Dave K: Two asks: limit to customers with account tag beta_quant=true, and keep KV cache behavior identical (no cache key changes).
Ashley P: I added a feature flag entry in our flag store for visibility:
```json
{
  "flag": "features.precision_profiles.sherpa_v2",
  "value": {"enabled": false, "audience": "beta_quant", "rollout_pct": 0}
}
```
Sam Nguyen: Thanks. I'll stage the flag and flip to 5% at 09:00 PST tomorrow. Any objections?
Leo Kim: Quick FYI — the int8 binary was compiled with kernel v3.2 and latency microbenchmarks look good. We should still watch p95 < 200ms for the canary.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] sherpa-quant-canary -> 2026-03-05T09:00:00-08:00 by Sam Nguyen
Maria Chen: Add auto-rollback triggers: halluc_rate > 0.015 OR token_loss increase > 0.005 relative to baseline, OR latency_p95 > 220ms for a 10m sliding window.
Sam Nguyen: Ack. I'll codify this rollout policy: auto-rollback if (halluc_rate > 0.015) OR (latency_p95 > 220ms) OR (token_err_rate > 0.005) over 10m. Also include manual approval stop.
Ashley P: Pinging @Dave K for a quick CR on the flag gating logic — link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/refs/heads/main#L123 (PR 1234)
Dave K: Reviewing now. Found a small race when the SDK refreshes flags mid-request; adding a test and small fix to ensure consistency.
Sam Nguyen: If no blockers, I'll flip at 09:00. @Leo Kim can you be on-call for traces?
Leo Kim: On-call confirmed, will monitor traces and p95. :eyes:
Maria Chen: Also constrain region to reduce blast radius (region=us-west-2) in the audience rule.
Sam Nguyen: Updated audience to: beta_quant AND region:us-west-2, rollout 5%. Updated flag payload in staging.
deploy-bot: [deploy executed] sherpa-quant-canary -> success. canary_id=canary-1779004567-1
Ashley P: Dashboards are live here: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/canary/canary-1779004567-1
Dave K: Saw a small uptick in tokenization errors at t+7m (~1.2%). Investigating potential vocab mismatch between quant step and tokenizer.
Maria Chen: If token_err_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m, we should rollback immediately.
Sam Nguyen: Token errors hit 0.9% at t+12m, initiating rollback to fp16 now.
deploy-bot: [rollback executed] sherpa-quant-canary -> rolled back to sherpa-v2-fp16. reason=tokenization_error_rate
Sam Nguyen: Postmortem note: add a vocab compatibility check to the quant pipeline and include it in the canary checklist. Also add a small offline re-tokenization test as part of CI.
Ashley P: Creating a ticket for follow-ups: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-889
Leo Kim: I'll add a unit test to assert vocab id remapping invariants in the quant step.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — plan: patch pipeline, add tests, then re-run with a 1% phased canary once green. :thumbsup:
Sam Nguyen: Sounds good. Will update this thread when the patched canary is scheduled.
